name: 72118 · N Little Rock, AR
findings: ZIP 72118 (N Little Rock) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72118 (N Little Rock) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
